definitions.explanation: a systematic set of rules or conventions for assigning names, used in science, computing, business, and other fields that require consistent naming

examples.japanese: ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命名法|めいめいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦{統一|とういつ}→統一：04551_touitsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{命名法|めいめいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Having a unified naming convention makes things easier to understand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生物学|せいぶつがく}→生物学：07107_seibutsugaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二名法|にめいほう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧{命名法|めいめいほう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{属名|ぞくめい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{種名|しゅめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせて→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧{学名|がくめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: In biology, a naming system called binomial nomenclature combines the genus name and species name to form the scientific name.

notes:
Combines ⟦{命名|めいめい}→命名：12030_meimei⟧ (naming) and ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (method, system). Used across many fields where systematic naming is important: chemistry (IUPAC nomenclature), biology (binomial nomenclature), computing (variable naming conventions), and corporate branding.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{命名法|めいめいほう}: international nomenclature
- ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧{命名法|めいめいほう}: chemical nomenclature
- {命名法|めいめいほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow a naming convention
- {命名法|めいめいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定|さだ}める→定める：10448_sadameru⟧: to establish a naming convention

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{命名|めいめい}→命名：12030_meimei⟧: naming — the act of giving a name, without implying a system
- ⟦{名称|めいしょう}→名称：12031_meishou⟧: name; designation — the name itself, not the system for choosing it
- {用語法|ようごほう}: terminology — the system of terms used in a field
